bootstrap_method: Model-cluster multinomial weights, all ordered cross-identity negatives weighted by product; identical identities excluded; degenerate one-identity draws omitted and counted; percentile intervals conditional on observed model pool.

precision.metadata_source: saved target config; provider identity in response logs; not attested precision
precision.limitations: Provider/hardware/precision confounded; lpu and official do not specify numerical precision; T1b is descriptive pooled detection, not controlled causal attribution.

named_palette.source: matplotlib.colors.CSS4_COLORS; includes rebeccapurple; aliases collapse to same RGB

priors.tokenization: Raw cloud logs contain output text and usage counts, not per-token segmentation. No BPE mechanism or alignment causality is inferred.
